sections.Description:
Stop Ronan from using the Infinity Stone!

The game will immerse players in a dynamic, challenging, and galactic pinball environment where Star-Lord, Rocket, Gamora, Drax the Destroyer, and Groot battle Ronan to stop him from using the Infinity Stone to destroy the galaxy.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- GROOOOOT: Start multiballs by shooting the custom sculpted and interactive ball-eating Groot. Open his mouth to lock balls and start playfield mulitpliers.
- Reveal the Infinity Stone: Color-changing inserts highlight the mysterious and interactive Orb, which opens to reveal the powerful Infinity Stone.
- Ronan Watches: Beware as Ronan will take over during Multiball using three playfield magnets in the middle of the playfield to divert balls and create multiball chaos.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- One playfield magnet in the middle of the playfield to divert balls and create multiball chaos.
- Featuring striking original hand-drawn art by artist Christopher Franchi.
- RGB LED Hadron Enforcer Action Button on front molding.

Premium:
- Three playfield magnets in the middle of the playfield to divert balls and create multiball chaos.
- Two high-speed ramps that extend through the backpanel.
- Custom molded Groot arms that extend over the playfield.

Limited Edition:
- Designer Autographed by game designer John Borg.
- Limited Edition includes Mirrored Backglass, Art Blades & Shaker Motor with Powder-coated gold side armor, hinges and front lockdown molding.
- Custom molded Groot arms that extend over the playfield.
